dataGaps.note: Decree №211 Annex 1 has no row for: VA (Holy See). Settlement stays undetermined unless a rate is entered manually; Italy's row is not borrowed.

Missions are those listed in the supplied annexes; their current operational status (e.g. Donetsk) is not verified.
